title: LynhanSMP Modpack
description: Lightweight, compact, vanilla-like mods with small QOLs, fun mods for me and the boys
body:
## Lynhan SMP Modpack
This is a project where I made a cool little private MC Server for me and friends to spend time on. This modpack will have some QOL, funny client-side mods to get my friend's ~~potato~~ beefy gaming rigs to play Minecraft smoothly. Also it will contain some universal mods so that we can have more content like bosses, weapons and roleplay-oriented to play around instead and improve player interaction rather than just a normal Minecraft gameplay.
